verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents its own RESTful API for processing applicant data programmatically, which gives headless operation without the dashboard. It also offers a Sandbox mode for testing integrations with app tokens and webhooks, and an MCP server for agent-driven operations. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines specifically: there is no CLI, no CI guidance, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: official CLI or CI/CD integration docs, a published OpenAPI spec for automated tooling, hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: With the Sumsub API, you can process the applicant data and documents submitted for verification through simple RESTful APIs.
Set up and test your integration using app tokens, webhooks, and our WebSDK.
Use the MCP server to let AI agents perform Sumsub operations on your behalf
